id: 480-意大利征服達爾馬提亞行省
theater: 薩洛納與達爾馬提亞濱海

battle.name: 意大利征服達爾馬提亞行省
battle.theater: 薩洛納與達爾馬提亞濱海
battle.brief: 四八〇年西羅馬皇帝涅波斯在薩洛納身亡，達爾馬提亞行省失去唯一的帝國政府，奧多亞塞的義大利王國隨後兼併全境，抵抗到四八五年才被清除。晚期羅馬那套封鎖壕溝、攻城塔、撞錘與投石機的圍城體系，正是在這樣的石砌城牆前才有用武之地。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭是五世紀初西羅馬帝國崩解的最後一場兼併：西邊是奧多亞塞一手建立的義大利王國，東邊是仍自居西羅馬正統、以薩洛納為基地的達爾馬提亞政權。奧多亞塞一方以從北邊下來的日耳曼同盟軍（foederati）為主體，加上義大利境內殘存的羅馬軍團與官僚系統；指揮上由王本人直接統率，他把自己的兄弟奧努爾福斯派往亞得里亞東岸，自己坐鎮拉文納。達爾馬提亞一方則是先後兩個規模很小的朝廷：四七六至四八〇年的尤利烏斯·涅波斯朝廷，以及四八三至四八五年由其弟瑪爾凱利努斯主持的政府；兩者都靠薩洛納的城防、海鹽的收入與東羅馬皇帝的冊封維持，兵員以晚期羅馬軍團殘部與達爾馬提亞徵召的民兵為主。第三方是東羅馬皇帝芝諾：他沒有派一兵一卒進場，卻是這場兼併真正的裁判，因為薩洛納的西羅馬皇帝頭銜正是東羅馬的冊封物，涅波斯一死，東羅馬對達爾馬提亞的義務就跟著消失。還有西哥德人捲入：五世紀初的西哥德王狄奧多里克當時就在巴爾幹，又娶了瑪爾凱利努斯的女兒奧瑪拉弗里達，捲入行省的爭端；四八〇至四八二年他曾以代表帝國的名義進攻義大利，卻在西格爾德率領的法蘭克人與奧多亞塞的阻撓下受挫退回，此後在芝諾支持下捲土重來，反而把行省的歸屬又翻了一次。
countriesEn: This war was an annexation carried out in the last stage of the collapse of the Western Roman Empire: on the one side the Kingdom of Italy created by Odoacer, on the other the Dalmatian government that still claimed Western Roman legitimacy and was based at Salona. Odoacer's side was built on the Germanic foederati who had come down from the north, together with the surviving Roman legions and administrative apparatus of Italy; command rested with the king himself, who posted his brother Onoulphus to the eastern Adriatic and sat at Ravenna. The Dalmatian side was one of two very small governments in turn: the court of Julius Nepos from 476 to 480, and the government his brother Marcellinus headed from 483 to 485; both lived on the walls of Salona, on the revenue of the salt pans and on the recognition of the eastern court, and their troops were the rump of the late Roman legions mixed with Dalmatian recruits. A third party is the eastern emperor Zeno, who put not a single soldier into the province and yet was the real arbiter of the annexation, because the title of Western emperor at Salona was a grant of the eastern court, and when Nepos died the eastern obligation toward Dalmatia died with him. The Visigoths also counted: Theodoric, king of the Visigoths, was in the Balkans at the time and was bound to the Dalmatian house by marriage, having married Amalafrida, the daughter of Marcellinus; between 480 and 482 he marched into Italy in the name of the empire, was checked by the Franks under Sigibert and by Odoacer, and withdrew, and later he came back with Zeno's backing and reversed the ownership of the province once more.
people: 關鍵人物幾乎集中在五個人身上。奧多亞塞（約西元四三三至四九三年）出身北方的斯克利人部族，父奧杜亞是軍官，他靠同盟軍首領的地位在四七六年廢掉羅慕路斯·奧古斯都魯斯、殺死奧雷斯特之後自立為義大利之王；他從不稱帝，只以王與執政官的身分對待羅馬臣民，把東羅馬的使節擋在門外。四八〇年他做了一件決定西歐走向的事：西羅馬皇帝尤利烏斯·涅波斯在薩洛納被殺——約爾丹尼斯說是奧多亞塞的士兵所為，普羅科匹烏斯則說是墮馬而亡——行省失去了唯一帶著皇帝名分的政府。涅波斯本是萊奧一世在四七四年冊立的西羅馬皇帝，勢力卻從未越出達爾馬提亞，駐節薩洛納，靠東羅馬的撥款與當地稅收維持朝廷；他的兄弟瑪爾凱利努斯在四八三年接手，以城為堡、以海為路，拒絕向奧多亞塞稱臣，兩人之間的角力一直延續到薩洛納被攻破為止。第五個人是狄奧多里克大帝：他當時是西哥德人的國王，又娶了瑪爾凱利努斯的女兒奧瑪拉弗里達，因此被拖進達爾馬提亞的爭端；四八〇至四八二年他以東羅馬的名義進攻義大利卻在維羅納受挫，之後退回巴爾幹，八八八年再受芝諾冊封為意大利總督，次年帶東哥德人入關，最終在四九三年拿下拉文納、逐走奧多亞塞。史料則主要來自約爾丹尼斯的《哥特人史》、普羅科匹烏斯《戰史》後段與《建築記》，以及只剩殘篇的馬爾凱利努斯編年史；正因為流傳下來的記載如此零碎，攻城器械這一層幾乎完全無字可考。
peopleEn: The decisive figures are concentrated in five men. Odoacer, who died in 493 and was born about 433, came from the Scirian tribe of the north, his father Odwacer being an officer, and he rose as leader of the foederati, killing Orestes and deposing Romulus Augustulus in 476 before setting himself up as king of Italy; he never called himself emperor, and dealt with Roman subjects as a king and a consul, keeping eastern envoys at a distance. In 480 he did the deed that decided the shape of the West: the Western emperor Julius Nepos was killed at Salona, whether by the soldiers of Odoacer as Jordanes has it or by a fall from his horse as Procopius has it, and the province lost the only government that still bore an imperial title. Nepos had been the Western emperor set up by Leo I in 474, yet his power never extended past Dalmatia; he sat at Salona supported by eastern subsidies and local taxes. His brother Marcellinus took over in 483, using the city as a fortress and the sea as a road, and refused to acknowledge Odoacer, and the two men sparred until Salona was taken. The fifth figure is Theodoric the Great. He was at that moment king of the Visigoths and married Amalafrida, the daughter of Marcellinus, so he was pulled into the Dalmatian quarrel; between 480 and 482 he invaded Italy in the name of the eastern empire but was checked at Verona, withdrew to the Balkans, and in 488 was commissioned by Zeno as magister militum per Italiam, leading the Ostrogoths over the Alps, taking Ravenna in 493 and putting Odoacer to the sword. The written record comes mainly from Jordanes' Getica, from the later books of Procopius' Wars and Buildings, and from the fragmentary Chronicle of Marcellinus; because the transmission is so thin, the layer of siege machinery is almost entirely blank.
kits: 卡面是投石機（onager），羅馬晚期最重型的扭力式投射機，也是這套圍城技術的頂點。它由木製機身、繃緊的牛筋與馬毛扭力束和一根長投臂組成，臂端繫著兜網，把一枚約十公斤重的石彈甩出；操作需要十人上下的專人班底，發射一次之後要重新上緊扭力，因此實際上是靠連續壓制而不是靠瞬間齊射的武器。存世的實物與復原件——最有名的是出自密亞、後來在佩加蒙博物館重建的那一具——顯示它能把石彈送到一百五十到三百公尺之間，足以壓制城牆頭的守軍與正在接近的攻城塔。位置要說清楚：這場戰爭的記載裡幾乎沒有留下任何一座投石機的名字，薩洛納與埃皮達魯姆的攻城細節在編年史裡幾乎空白；但可以確定的是，晚期羅馬的攻城序列正是由這類器械組成——封鎖壕溝、進逼坑道與土壘、攻城塔、撞錘，以及負責壓制塔頭的投石機，而奧多亞塞的義大利王國完整繼承了這套工程技術與它的工匠班底，薩洛納的石砌城牆與塔樓也正是這類機械的主要目標。其餘裝備同樣是晚期羅馬的組合：步兵用短劍與標槍、靠盾牌列成龜甲陣前進，弓手與弩炮車（carroballista）負責平射壓制，騎兵靠人和馬的重量；攻城方另有撞錘、覆革的攻城塔、堆土的坡道，以及靠海岸與駁船運糧的後勤車隊。真正值得記住的是壽命：扭力式投石機並沒有在五世紀初消失，普羅科匹烏斯在六世紀三十年代仍記載羅馬軍用石砲與攻城塔對付東哥德人，它一直要到更晚才被配重式的擲石器取代——達爾馬提亞的存亡從來不是由某一台機械決定的。
kitsEn: The card shows the onager, the heaviest torsion-powered missile weapon of the late Roman army and the summit of that siege technology. It consisted of a timber frame, a skein of twisted sinew and horsehair, and a long throwing arm with a sling at its tip that whipped out a stone shot of about ten kilograms; it needed a crew of around ten trained men, and since the skein had to be reset after every shot it was a weapon of sustained pressure rather than of salvo fire. Surviving originals and reconstructions, most famously the one from Mysia later rebuilt at the Pergamon Museum, show it could place its shot between one hundred fifty and three hundred metres, enough to silence the defenders on a wall and any siege tower moving up beneath it. The position must be stated plainly: no onager is named in any account of this war, and the sieges of Salona and Epidaurum are almost blank in the chronicles; what can be established is that the late Roman siege sequence was made up of precisely this family of machines, a circumvallation ditch, an approach trench and agger, siege towers, rams, and stone throwers to keep the parapets down, and that Odoacer's Kingdom of Italy inherited that engineering and its craftsmen wholesale, while the stone walls and towers of Salona were exactly the kind of target such machines existed for. The rest of the equipment is the late Roman mixture as well: infantry with gladius and pilum advancing in testudo, archers and carroballistae for flat trajectories, cavalry relying on the weight of horse and rider; on the attacking side, rams, leather-clad siege towers, earthen ramps, and a baggage train fed by coastal shipping and barges. What is worth remembering is the longevity: torsion stone-throwers did not vanish in the early fifth century. Procopius still records Roman stone throwers and siege towers used against the Ostrogoths in the 530s, and the machine was only displaced later by the counterweight trebuchet. The fate of Dalmatia was never decided by one machine.
tactics: 打法和攻城技術在晚期都是可以推敲的，因為雙方都面對同一種地形：達爾馬提亞是亞得里亞海東岸一條狹長的海岸帶，迪納拉阿爾卑斯的石灰岩山脊把行省切成幾塊沿海平地，薩洛納背靠一片可耕可曬鹽的腹地，往南是埃皮達魯姆與里斯塔的港口，北面則是通向斯普利特與內雷特瓦的陸路。奧多亞塞一方能用的辦法有三種：一是從海上切斷——薩洛納面向陸地，但港口與島嶼之間可以由小艇與帆船控制，斷掉對方的鹽與糧食外運；二是以騎兵與輕兵封住通往內陸的山口與渡口，讓城裡只能靠城牆自守；三是攻城本身，按晚期羅馬的標準程序做：先在外圍拉出一道封鎖線，再挖壕溝、堆土壘接近，攻城塔推到牆下，撞錘處理門與牆基，投石機則在後方連續壓制塔頭。約爾丹尼斯留下的記載卻說明，真正解決問題的往往不是器械：奧多亞塞最初派奧努爾福斯前往攻擊，據說未能取下薩洛納，之後改以欺騙的方式把瑪爾凱利努斯從城裡引誘出來，在一次集會中將他殺死，行省才真正落到義大利王國手上。守方那幾年做的事則是純粹的拖延與外交：守住城牆、維持東羅馬的承認、把每一次進攻的損失壓到最低。同一時期的另一場戰爭可以作對照：四八〇至四八二年狄奧多里克率西哥德人越過阿爾卑斯進入意大利，先在北部平原與奧多亞塞周旋，又被西格爾德率領的法蘭克人牽制在維羅納城下，最後拿了錢退走——說明五世紀初的意大利，勝負常常由聯盟而不是攻城術決定。
tacticsEn: The methods of both sides can be reasoned out, because both faced the same terrain: Dalmatia was a narrow coastal strip on the eastern Adriatic, and the Dinaric limestone ridges cut the province into a few coastal flats, with Salona backed by a hinterland that could be ploughed and could boil salt, Epidaurum and Lissus lying to the south, and the land road towards Salona and the interior running north. Odoacer had three courses open to him. The first was to cut the province off by sea: Salona faced inland, but its harbour and the islands could be held by small craft and sailing vessels, shutting off the salt and the grain that moved out. The second was to seal the passes and fords with cavalry and light troops, so that the city could only be defended behind its own wall. The third was the siege itself, carried out by the late Roman procedure: a circumvallation drawn up outside, then a ditch and a ramp of earth brought close in, siege towers advanced to the foot of the wall, rams applied to the gates and the wall foot, and stone throwers working from behind to keep the parapets down. Yet the record shows that machinery was often not what settled such a matter. Jordanes has it that Odoacer first sent Onoulphus and could not take Salona, and then had Marcellinus lured out of the city and killed in an assembly, and only then did the province really pass to the Kingdom of Italy. What the defenders did through those years was pure delay and diplomacy: hold the walls, keep the recognition of the eastern empire alive, and make every assault cost the attacker more than it gained. A useful contrast comes from the same years: between 480 and 482 Theodoric led the Visigoths over the Alps into Italy, fought Odoacer in the northern plains, was held off by the Franks under Sigibert before Verona, and finally took payment and withdrew, showing that in the early fifth century the outcome in Italy was usually decided by alliances rather than by siegecraft.
data: 可用的數字不多，而且多半是約數。人口與城市方面，薩洛納是晚期帝國最發達的城市之一，帝國時期的人口常被估在數萬量級，晚期落到兩萬到五萬之間；行省面積約兩萬五千平方公里上下，各時期劃分不同，估算也有出入；達爾馬提亞在四八〇年代仍以海鹽著稱，鹽場是行省最重要的現金收入。距離與行程方面，從拉文納到薩洛納，沿亞得里亞海岸約六百到七百公里，海路順風不過數日，陸路走縱貫半島的大道需數週；薩洛納到埃皮達魯姆約一百公里、到里斯塔約二百公里，公路沿著山麓與海岸盤旋，任何一支進攻軍隊都要在狹窄的海岸通道裡行軍。器械的量級是：石彈約十公斤一發，班底十人上下，有效射程常被放在一百五十到三百公尺之間，依復原實驗而異，一次齊射可以讓一段城牆在一段時間內抬不起頭。日期方面，涅波斯死在四八〇年，瑪爾凱利努斯掌達爾馬提亞約兩年，約在四八四年或四八五年被殺，行省併入義大利王國的過程因此長達五到六年；戰爭列表把這場戰爭繫於四八〇年，對應的是行省失去皇帝、落入王國管轄的那一年，而真正的城破還要再晚幾年。史料沒有留下確切的月份與雙方兵員，這兩項只能從編制推想：奧多亞塞在義大利能調用的同盟軍總數在任何文獻裡都沒有留下，一般只以數千人到一萬餘人這個量級來把握，那只能當作級別的參考；薩洛納一側的守軍規模要小得多，多半是幾百到一兩千人的城防部隊與民兵。
dataEn: Few usable numbers survive, and most of them are approximations. On population and cities, Salona was one of the most developed cities of the late empire, its population commonly estimated at something in the tens of thousands in the imperial period and falling to between twenty and fifty thousand in the late period; the area of the province was on the order of twenty-five thousand square kilometres, though the boundaries shifted from period to period and the estimates differ; Dalmatia was still famous for sea salt in the 480s, and the salt pans were the province's most important source of cash. On distance and travel, from Ravenna to Salona the Adriatic coast road ran about six to seven hundred kilometres, a matter of a few days by sea in fair wind and several weeks on the long road across the peninsula; Salona to Epidaurum was about a hundred kilometres and to Lissus about two hundred, the road winding between the foot of the mountains and the shore, so that any army of invasion had to march through a narrow coastal corridor. The scale of the machines: a stone shot of about ten kilograms, a crew of around ten, an effective range commonly put between one hundred fifty and three hundred metres depending on the reconstruction, and a single discharge able to keep a stretch of the wall from raising its head. On dates, Nepos died in 480; Marcellinus held Dalmatia for about two years and was killed in 484 or 485, so the process of annexation ran for five or six years. The list of wars hangs this conflict on 480, the year in which the province lost its emperor and passed under royal rule, while the actual storming of the city came a few years later. The sources preserve neither an exact month nor any reliable count of the opposing forces, and those two figures can only be inferred from the organisation: the body of foederati Odoacer could draw on in Italy is nowhere recorded and is generally treated as an order of magnitude running from several thousand to a dozen thousand or more, which is a matter of scale rather than a return; the garrison of Salona was much smaller, probably some hundreds to a thousand or two of city troops and militia.
cause: 打起來有三層原因。最深的一層是四七〇年代西羅馬帝位的連續崩解：四七五年，奧雷斯特廢掉小皇帝羅慕路斯·奧古斯都魯斯，改立自己的兒子；被東方皇帝萊奧一世支持的尤利烏斯·涅波斯從達爾馬提亞反攻，卻在本土站不住腳，退回薩洛納；四七六年奧多亞塞殺死奧雷斯特、廢掉羅慕路斯·奧古斯都魯斯，把皇帝的璽印與衣冠送回君士坦丁堡，自己卻以王自居。於是在四八〇年之前，西羅馬只剩下一點點：亞平寧半島由一個日耳曼王統治，東部皇帝承認一位住在達爾馬提亞、靠東部撥款養活的西羅馬皇帝。這種局面本身就是在等一次清算。第二層是直接觸發：四八〇年涅波斯在薩洛納身亡，暗殺說與墮馬說各有其人，達爾馬提亞頓時既沒有皇帝，也失去東羅馬的義務；奧多亞塞隨即接手這個行省，把它從皇帝的行省變成王的領地，同時切斷薩洛納與君士坦丁堡之間的財政與使節往來。第三層是雙方要的東西不同：奧多亞塞要的是達爾馬提亞的鹽、田與港口收入，是讓義大利王國在財政上真正獨立、讓自己不只是替皇帝看家的野蠻首領；瑪爾凱利努斯要的是維持西羅馬的正統，用薩洛納這個仍保有帝國行政傳統的港口城市做基地，證明西部帝國並未真正滅亡。夾在中間的東羅馬有自己的算盤：芝諾既不肯出兵，也不願放棄對西方皇帝名號的壟斷，於是坐看奧多亞塞與薩洛納互相消耗，最後再把狄奧多里克推上去收拾殘局。
causeEn: There are three layers of reason. The deepest is the serial collapse of the western imperial throne in the 470s. In 475 Orestes deposed the boy emperor Romulus Augustulus and crowned his own son; Julius Nepos, backed by the eastern emperor Leo I, counter-attacked from Dalmatia but could not hold ground in Italy and fell back to Salona; in 476 Odoacer killed Orestes, deposed Romulus Augustulus, and sent the imperial regalia to Constantinople, while ruling as a king in his own right. The result was that before 480 the only thing left of the Western Empire was this: the peninsula under a Germanic king, and a Western Roman emperor on the eastern payroll, living in Dalmatia. Such a situation was waiting to be settled. The second layer is the immediate trigger. In 480 Nepos was killed at Salona, and both an assassination and a fall from a horse are on the record, so Dalmatia was at once without an emperor and without any eastern obligation; Odoacer took the province over, turning an imperial province into a royal demesne and cutting the financial and diplomatic tie between Salona and Constantinople. The third layer is that the two sides wanted different things. Odoacer wanted the salt, the fields and the harbours of Dalmatia, so that the Kingdom of Italy would be financially independent and he would be more than a barbarian chief keeping house for an emperor. Marcellinus wanted to keep Western Roman legitimacy alive, using Salona, a port city that still held the administrative traditions of the empire, as a base to show that the western empire had not truly died. The eastern emperor had his own arithmetic: Zeno would not send troops, and would not let go of his monopoly on the western imperial title either, so he sat back and let Odoacer and Salona exhaust each other, before finally pushing Theodoric in to clear up the mess.
impact: 影響分近遠兩層。近的一層是版圖與財政：義大利王國的疆界從亞平寧半島伸到亞得里亞東岸，鹽稅、耕地與港口的關稅讓一個原本靠劫掠維持的小國有了經常性收入；但同時，行省原有的羅馬官僚、稅冊與城市精英被削弱，薩洛納從晚期帝國的五座核心城市之一降為邊地上的王國前哨，維持城牆與公共工程的經費被削減，後來城市大幅縮水的原因之一，就在這幾年的治理真空。近的一層還有戰略上的代價：四八〇至四八五年奧多亞塞把兵力與注意力壓在東岸，同一時期他要在高盧對付西格爾德與法蘭克人，四八四年在西格爾德手下失利，四八六年又在克洛維斯手下失利；兼併達爾馬提亞之後，他沒有一兵一卒可以調去支援高盧，義大利王國的崩解其實在四八八年之前就已被預告。遠的一層是結構性的：四八〇年之後，再沒有一個西羅馬皇帝被整個西方承認，正統論的史家因此把這一年與四七六年的廢黜一起，當作西部帝國的終點。而這場兼併本身也只維持了不到十年：四八八年芝諾改變態度，冊封狄奧多里克為意大利總督，東哥德人南下，就在這一年由奧多沃爾夫奪回達爾馬提亞；四八九年巴杜伊拉率哥德騎兵在維羅納擊潰奧多亞塞的軍隊，四九〇年奧多亞塞在阿爾達河反過來擊敗狄奧多里克，最終狄奧多里克圍困拉文納，四九三年二月奧多亞塞被處死，達爾馬提亞隨之歸入東哥特王國，直到五五三年哥特戰爭結束才重回東羅馬。武器史的尾聲也在這條線上：羅馬晚期這套扭力投射機體系在五世紀末到六世紀仍在使用，普羅科匹烏斯在六世紀三十年代還寫得出一整套圍城機械的細節，而它真正被取代，還要等到東羅馬換上配重式擲石器之後。
impactEn: The effects work at two distances. The nearer one is territory and revenue: the Kingdom of Italy now stretched from the Apennines to the eastern Adriatic, and salt duties, farmland and port dues gave a small state that had lived on plunder a regular income. At the same time the Roman bureaucracy, tax registers and urban elite of the province were hollowed out, and Salona sank from one of the five core cities of the late empire to a forward post of the kingdom on a frontier; the money for maintaining walls and public works was cut, and the sharp shrinking of the city later in the sixth century has part of its explanation in those years of administrative vacuum. The nearer effect is also strategic, and it was expensive: between 480 and 485 Odoacer had his forces and his attention pinned to the eastern shore while at the same time he had to face Sigibert and the Franks in Gaul, losing to Sigibert in 484 and to Clovis in 486. Having annexed Dalmatia he had not one man to send west, and the collapse of the Kingdom of Italy was already foretold before 488. The deeper effect is structural. After 480 no Western Roman emperor was ever acknowledged by the whole of the West, and orthodox historians therefore take that year, together with the deposition of 476, as the end of the Western Empire. The annexation itself lasted less than ten years: in 488 Zeno changed his policy, commissioned Theodoric as magister militum per Italiam, and the Ostrogoths came south, taking Dalmatia in 488 under Odovulf. In 489 Baduila's Gothic horse beat Odoacer's men at Verona; in 490 Odoacer beat Theodoric at the Arda; and after the siege of Ravenna the Ostrogothic kingdom replaced the Italian one, with Dalmatia following it until the Gothic War ended in 553 and the province returned to the eastern empire. The epilogue in the history of weapons lies on the same line: the late Roman system of torsion artillery was still in use at the end of the fifth and through the sixth century, Procopius in the 530s could still set out the details of a whole siege train, and it was only retired when the counterweight trebuchet came into use in the eastern empire.
result: 結果很簡單：行省被兼併，抵抗被清除，但兼併沒有帶來穩定。四八〇年奧多亞塞接管達爾馬提亞的行政，四八三年起雙方在薩洛納周旋，約在四八四年或四八五年，瑪爾凱利努斯在城中被誘出並被殺，薩洛納與整個行省正式併入義大利王國；自此西方的西部只剩一個亞平寧半島上的日耳曼王國，和一個在四八〇年之後再也沒有人承認的西羅馬皇帝頭銜。就軍事而言，這是一場代價極低、收益很實的兼併：行省沒有被洗劫，城市沒有被焚毀，城牆與港口被原樣接管；但收益只兌現了八到九年，因為四八八年東哥德人回來，四八九年巴杜伊拉在維羅納擊敗奧多亞塞的軍隊，四九〇年奧多亞塞在阿爾達河擊敗狄奧多里克，最終狄奧多里克圍困拉文納數月，四九三年二月奧多亞塞被處死，達爾馬提亞隨之歸入東哥特王國。卡面上的投石機在這整段故事裡從未留下名字：薩洛納不是被石砲打下來的，而是被一次集會、一次刺殺與一連串外交解決的。真正決定結局的是合法性、聯盟與財政——東羅馬的態度、法蘭克人與勃艮第人的牽制、鹽稅的流向，以及誰能讓西部的人相信皇帝還在。若說這件兵器還留下什麼，那就是它背後那整套晚期羅馬工程技術的壽命：扭力式投石機、攻城塔與撞錘的組合在意大利平原上又用了半個多世紀，六世紀的普羅科匹烏斯仍然寫得出整套圍城機械的細節，而它們真正退場，要等到東羅馬換上配重式擲石器、以及羅馬的城牆徹底失去意義的那個時代。
resultEn: The result is simple: the province was annexed and the resistance was removed, but the annexation brought no stability. In 480 Odoacer took over the administration of Dalmatia; from 483 the two sides sparred around Salona, and in 484 or 485 Marcellinus was lured out of the city and killed, after which Salona and the whole province passed formally into the Kingdom of Italy. From that point on the West had only a Germanic kingdom on the Apennine peninsula and a Western imperial title that nobody would ever acknowledge again. Militarily it was an annexation of very low cost and solid gain: the province was not sacked, its cities were not burned down, and its walls and harbours were taken over intact. But the gain was cashed in for less than a decade. In 488 the Ostrogoths came back; in 489 Baduila's cavalry beat Odoacer's men at Verona; in 490 Odoacer beat Theodoric at the Arda; Theodoric besieged Ravenna through the winter, and in February 493 Odoacer was executed and Dalmatia passed with the rest to the Ostrogothic kingdom. The onager on the card never gets a name in that story: Salona was not taken down by stone-shot, but by an assembly, an assassination and a run of diplomacy. What decided the outcome was legitimacy, alliances and revenue, the attitude of the eastern court, the interference of the Franks and Burgundians, where the salt tax flowed, and who could persuade the people of the West that an emperor still existed. If the machine left anything behind, it was the longevity of the late Roman engineering system it stood for: the combination of torsion stone-thrower, siege tower and ram worked the plains of Italy for another half century or more, and Procopius could still set out the details of a whole siege train in the sixth century before it was retired in favour of the counterweight trebuchet and before the walls of Rome lost all meaning.
